8.4.1.7 Nm_RemoteSleepCancellation
[SWS_Nm_00193] Definition of callback function Nm_RemoteSleepCancellation
Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00359, RS_Nm_02509
⌈
Service Name
Nm_RemoteSleepCancellation
Syntax
void Nm_RemoteSleepCancellation (
NetworkHandleType nmNetworkHandle
)
Service ID [hex]
0x18
Sync/Async
Asynchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant
Parameters (in)
nmNetworkHandle
Identification of the NM-channel
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
None
Description
Notification that the network management has detected that not all other nodes on the network
are longer ready to enter Bus-Sleep Mode.
Available via
Nm.h
⌋
[SWS_Nm_00278]
Upstream requirements: RS_Nm_00150
⌈Configuration of Nm_RemoteSleepCancellation: This function is only available if
NmRemoteSleepIndEnabled is set to TRUE.⌋
The notification that not all other nodes on the network are longer ready to enter Bus-
Sleep Mode is only needed for internal purposes of the NM Coordinator.
Note: When NM Coordinator functionality is disabled Nm_RemoteSleepCancella-
tion can be an empty function.
caption: 8.4.1.7 Nm_RemoteSleepCancellation

targets.why: Aborts coordinated shutdown upon remote sleep cancellation.
